purpose: Teach: 理性/排水/導い/促し/細部/巧み/相関/ヒロイン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 感情ではなく、本気で、絶対、理性、絶対、で、絶対、経営判断、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't think with emotion. I need you to make every management decision with absolute reason. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with weight. No wasted breath. Steady eye contact, shoulders set. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社の、本気で、絶対、排水、絶対、設備、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward with the headquarters drainage and equipment maintenance as planned. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Crisp, businesslike acknowledgment. Formal register — slight bow in the voice. Calm, organized, showing control of the situation. The response of someone who has his orders clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員を、本気で、絶対、導いた、絶対、メンター、絶対、表彰しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And commend the mentors who've been genuinely guiding our staff. That matters.
lines.style: Measured shift in tone — still authoritative but with a lighter touch. Recognition, not performance. A moment where the boss shows he notices the human side too.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、お客様への、絶対、購入を、絶対、促した、絶対、キャンペーン、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our customer acquisition campaign has been performing very well. We appreciate your direction on this.
lines.style: Bright, engaged report. A note of quiet pride in the news being delivered. Still formal, but warmer — the confidence of someone delivering good results.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約の、本気で、絶対、細部、絶対、まで、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: One more thing: verify every detail of the contracts. Don't cut corners there.
lines.style: Tone tightens again. Pointed, deliberate. The shift back to exacting standards. Not angry, but unmistakably firm — this is where precision matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、巧み、絶対、な、絶対、マーケティング、絶対、業界の注目です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our marketing strategy has been sharp, and we're getting real industry attention for it. Thank you for allowing us to execute at this level.
lines.style: Measured confidence. A slight lift in pace as the good news comes through. Professional but with genuine appreciation underneath — not obsequious, just respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 顧客満足度と業績の、本気で、絶対、相関、絶対、分析しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The customer satisfaction metrics and our financial performance are moving together. Analyze that correlation carefully.
lines.style: Leaning back into strategic mode. Thoughtful pace. This is a request that shows deeper thinking — the boss connecting dots, wanting verification. Authoritative but intellectually engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のCMの、本気で、絶対、ヒロイン、絶対、人気俳優、絶対、決定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've finalized the lead actress for the commercial. She's one of the most popular choices right now. Thank you for your approval.
lines.style: Warm closing note. A touch of relief — the hard work is done, the decision made. Still formal but slightly lighter, like crossing a finish line together. Respectful exhale.
